executive_assessment.text: The NDC reports Uzbekistan’s average temperature rose about 0.29°C per decade from the early 1950s, roughly twice the global rate.
For 2039 with 90% water availability, the NDC projects 10–13% cotton and winter-wheat yield losses and 10–12% for alfalfa under RCP4.5/8.5.
Planned social-sector adaptation includes climate-risk information, hydrometeorological early warnings, and greater participation by women and local communities in planning and management.

known_gaps.text: The 2021 NDC records government projections and planned adaptation; implementation status and updated subnational risk data were not checked.
